bms_current.battery_side: I_battery = I_CC2 - I_AUX_BATT if AUX current bypasses shunt and no other bypass
bms_current.bus_side: I_battery = I_CC2 - I_AUX_BUS if BUS+ -> AUX -> B0 -> shunt -> PACK-; currents must be measured or bounded

limitations: 0.85V is MDD RS1B max at 1A at the datasheet temperature point, not full-corner transient/source transfer bound.
Hi-Link startup <=18V voltage point is not an input-independent maximum startup time; 1ms is typical at nominal input/resistive load.
When battery-BUS difference is within possible diode Vf mismatch, actual sharing is unknown; precharge tail may supply part of AUX input.
Two source paths require separate fault-current-coordinated protection, connector, wire and input current characterization.

EARLY_GUARD_READY proves protection-domain qualification, not source identity; at BUS=0 the battery service path is the only energizing source; precharged BUS is handled by BMS direction/external-source checks.
B0-to-PACK- shunt and both output power conductors must be connected; U_AUX output hard short is outside selected single-event envelope.
Isolation rating and typical capacitance do not certify leakage/backfeed; measure precharge I(V,t,T).
